newsitem.title: USA: Rio sees Q3 EPS at $0.20, below estimates.
newsitem.headline: Rio sees Q3 EPS at $0.20, below estimates.

text.p: Rio Hotel & Casino Inc said Tuesday it expects to earn $0.20 a share for the third quarter, which is below analysts's estimates, due to higher operational costs for expanding its Las Vegas casino/hotel.
Analysts had expected the company to earn $0.24 a share in the quarter ending September 30, according to First Call.

In addition, Rio said it may see some impact on the fourth quarter's financial statements, also due to ongoing expansion. The company is expected to earn $0.23 a share for the fourth quarter based on seven analysts's forecasts reported to First Call.
Rio shares were off 1/2 at 15 immediately following the news of lower earnings. In a written statement, the company had cited analysts's third quarter estimates of $0.23 a share.
The company is currently expanding its hotel and casino in Las Vegas, building an addition called "Masquerade Village" designed to look like a turn-of-the-century European village.

The $200 million project is ahead of schedule, and Rio said it expects to open one-half of the new 1,028 rooms by January 1, 1997 and the remainder throughout the first quarter. A grand opening will be held on February 7 versus the original projection of April 1997, the company said.
Masquerade Village will contain 30,000 square feet of additional casino space with 400 slot machines and 20 table games. It will have five new restaurants and retail space.
Rio said it was "pleased" with third quarter results given the fast pace of construction and disruption of business.
Hotel occupancy was at 94 percent for this past third quarter compared with 94 percent for the 1995 third quarter.
A new 8,000 square foot High Limit pit and its Shutters Bar opened area earlier than the anticipated, but their construction disrupted other gambling operations.

Moreover, the brisk building pace for the overall expansion and Masquerade Village required the temporary removal of about 400 slot machines during the third quarter, a portion of o which will carry over into the fourth quarter.
